subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should generic paths shaped as channels.<kind>.accounts.<accountId> restart only that account across channel plugins, with default/global/mixed/unlisted fallbacks preserving whole-channel safety?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes a compatibility-sensitive reload contract shared by all channel plugins, so maintainer intent should confirm the generic rule before the candidate PR lands.

options.title: Confirm Generic Account-Scoped Reloads
options.body: Approve the current candidate shape so account-scoped config changes restart only affected accounts while documented fallbacks keep whole-channel safety.

options.title: Require Explicit Plugin Capability
options.body: Keep current whole-channel behavior unless a channel plugin explicitly opts into account-scoped reloads.

options.title: Defer The Contract
options.body: Leave the issue open without landing the generic fix until gateway owners define a narrower reload capability contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm Generic Account-Scoped Reloads
recommendation.body: Approve the current candidate shape so account-scoped config changes restart only affected accounts while documented fallbacks keep whole-channel safety.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest current-history route for the reload planner and channel lifecycle surfaces in this checkout.
